request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The score's settled figures now leave out corrections: only SETTLED claims that correct nothing
count toward it.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A person's score now counts only SETTLED claims that don't correct another claim. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The score is worked out in two places, so I changed both the same way:
- **Server** (`src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/rollup/RollupService.java`): the settled figures behind the score now leave out corrections. The `SCORE` audit records written while the score log is on use this figure too.
- **Front end** (`src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`): `scoreOf` leaves corrections out of the settled figures before working out the score, so the score and band shown on screen use the new rule.

The person's settled-total column and the "Settled in total" figure still include corrections. The request only mentions the score, so I left those alone.

Nothing in the stored data had to change, because claims already record which claim they correct.
